content.short: Plutus DAO is an Arbitrum-native governance aggregator that maximizes yield and liquidity for veTokens.
content.description:
Plutus DAO is a premier decentralized governance aggregator built natively for the Arbitrum network, designed to simplify and maximize rewards for DeFi participants. The protocol focuses on accumulating governance power (veTokens) from major Arbitrum protocols, such as GMX and Radiant, and tokenizing them into highly liquid "plsAssets" (e.g., plsGMX). This allow users to benefit from increased yields and influence without the logistical burden of manually managing multiple lock-up periods or voting weights.

Governed by the PLS token, the protocol features a sustainable revenue-sharing model where stakers receive a portion of platform fees. By providing a unified venue for governance participation and yield optimization, Plutus DAO serves as a vital infrastructure layer for the Arbitrum ecosystem. Through its commitment to transparency and community-driven development, Plutus DAO is empowering participants to build more sophisticated decentralized portfolios while maintaining total sovereignty over their digital capital.
content.meta: Plutus DAO provides decentralized governance aggregation and yield optimization for the Arbitrum network.
